body.name: Capacity-sensitivity FFRCISTG class with raw paths and separately capped summaries
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_H=\{\mathsf P:R\perp U;\ O\text{ is the }R\text{-indexed path in }U\text{ observed through }C;\ \mathsf P(R=a)>0;\ \mathsf P(S_k^a=1)>0;\ (Y_{\ell}^{1\to0},D_{\ell}^{1\to0})=(Y_{\ell}^{1},D_{\ell}^{1})\text{ for }\ell\le k;\ \mathsf P(W=w\mid S_k^1=1)=q_w;\ \mathsf P(B+W\le H\mid S_k^1=1)=1;\text{ and, for every }a\in\{0,1\},\ell\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\ \mathsf P(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,\mathcal H_K^a)=\mathsf P(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,\mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a)>0\text{ almost surely on }\{R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0\}\}\). The censoring restriction is arm specific and factual; it imposes no independence between \(C\) and unassigned counterfactual branches.
